title: ReadSharedFileInput
description: Fetch one of the project's shared files into your working directory as .agent-shared/<path> (the folder is git-ignored, like .agent-deliverables). With inline=true a UTF-8 text file of at most 64 KB is also returned as content. Shared files belong to the project: every session (coordinator, leads, members of all threads) and every user of the project can see, overwrite and delete them; they are stored by the platform, never in git. Do not put secrets (keys, passwords, tokens, credentials) in shared files. A file with the same path is overwritten. Limits: 20 MB per file, 500 MB per project. To change it, edit the local copy and call write_shared_file(file=.agent-shared/<path>).

path.description: Path in the shared files, for example data/sample.csv (see list_shared_files).

inline.description: Also return the text in the result (UTF-8 text files up to 64 KB only).

local_path.description: Where the file was written, relative to your working directory (.agent-shared/<path>; the daemon adds the absolute path). Absent when the session has no working directory.

content.description: The text, only with inline=true for a UTF-8 text file of at most 64 KB.
